name: xbert-fx-review
description: Review the period's FX-exposure XBerts (unrevalued balances, intercompany FX mismatches) — propose period-end revaluation journals.

x-xbert.tagline: Review the period's FX-exposure XBerts (unrevalued balances, intercompany FX mismatches) — propose period-end revaluation journals.
prerequisites: Client connected to a multi-currency ledger
FX XBerts linked to the FX Review agent in the Connect portal
x-xbert.longDescription:
FX exposure is detected deterministically by Custom XBerts — unrevalued foreign-currency balances, intercompany FX mismatches between trading entities, FX bank accounts requiring period-end revaluation, FX AR and AP with movement since the last revaluation. The XBerts do the detection; this plugin does not.

XBert FX Review orchestrates the review and proposes the period-end revaluation journal lines for partner approval. Plugin proposes — partner posts. Nothing is auto-applied.

Where the linked XBerts identify the exposure, the plugin synthesises the revaluation journal: per balance, the source amount in foreign currency, the rate at posting, the rate at period end, the gain or loss, and the offsetting P&L line. Every line in the proposed journal traces back to the source XBert and the underlying account.

useCases.title: Month or quarter-end FX revaluation
useCases.description: At every period close on a multi-currency client, surface unrevalued balances and propose the revaluation journal for the partner to approve before posting.

useCases.title: New multi-currency client setup
useCases.description: First period on a newly multi-currency client surfaces baseline FX exposure and the revaluation approach the practice will use ongoing.

useCases.title: Intercompany FX reconciliation
useCases.description: When two related entities trade in different currencies, the FX XBerts catch the mismatch and the plugin reconciles it in one place.

useCases.title: FX audit working paper
useCases.description: Year-end audit FX working paper assembled with the revaluation journal, supporting rates, and partner sign-off captured.

benefits.title: FX XBerts enforce deterministically
benefits.description: Unrevalued balances, intercompany mismatches and rate-movement exposure are caught by deterministic XBerts. The plugin reasons only over what fired.

benefits.title: Revaluation journal proposed
benefits.description: Per-balance proposed journal lines with source amount, posting rate, period-end rate, gain or loss and offsetting P&L line — ready for partner approval.

benefits.title: Partner approval gated
benefits.description: Plugin proposes; partner posts. Nothing is auto-applied — every journal line is signed off before it reaches the ledger.

workflow: Confirm the client and the review period (default: current open period)
Plugin resolves the linked FX XBerts for the period — if none are linked, the review stops and the user is prompted to configure linked XBerts first
A revaluation journal is proposed per balance with rates, gain/loss and offsetting P&L line
Partner reviews and approves the journal before it is posted to the ledger
